newsitem.title: USA: D&P rates Chrysler Financial offer single-A-minus.
newsitem.headline: D&P rates Chrysler Financial offer single-A-minus.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it has rated Chrysler Financial Corp's $300 million 6.975 percent senior note offering single-A-minus.
Chrysler Financial's ratings reflect the close marketing and financial ties with parent Chrysler Corp, whose senior debt is also rated single-A-minus, D&P said.

The Chrysler ratings reflect the improved balance sheet strength and financial flexibility and the expectation that the company could weather any auto sales downturn while continuing to invest in new product development and quality improvements, D&P said in a statement.

Chrysler Financial's full year 1996 earnings rose to $376 million from $339 million in 1995, benefiting from higher earnings assets levels, partly offset by increased loss provisions to offset higher retail credit losses. Fourth quarter 1996 earnings declined to $83 million from $97 million in the fourth quarter 1995, largely due to an increase in loss provisioning to bolster reserve levels and offset higher retail credit losses.
